summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py. It runs a callback (sync or coroutine) in the app's event loop via asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe, blocks until it returns, and returns the result. It raises RuntimeError when called from the app's own thread (would deadlock) or before the app is running. _process_messages now records self._loop and self._thread_id, and __init__ initialises them. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 3 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src, since the venv's textual is an editable install of a separate base checkout. Pre-existing async tests (test_call_later.py, parts of test_message_pump.py) fail in this venv because no async pytest plugin is installed; this is unrelated to the change. Nothing committed.
